# Old concept names still in the tree, per record of config/naming/concept_map.toml.
#
# One line per map record, keyed by the record's `new_code`:
#
#     <new_code>\t<files still carrying an old name>\t<matches>
#
# This is a ratchet, the same shape as turkish-baseline.txt and
# udeps-baseline.txt. The numbers may only fall. A record that goes up fails
# the gate; a record that goes down fails it too, until the line here is
# lowered with it, because a rename nobody records is a rename the next
# package cannot see. The key is the new code name rather than the old one so
# this file stays English (tree_is_english) while the map it counts is not.
#
# When the last package has renamed what it owns, WP-43 sets `mode` to
# "absolute" in the map and every line below must read 0\t0.
#
# Produced by the concept-names gate's own scan; regenerate with
# `cargo run --release --manifest-path xtask/gates/Cargo.toml -- concept-names`
# and copy the replacement lines the gate prints.
